tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on paper, off-white and mist. Solid fill for the active filter tab, the ticker band and Gym A schedule blocks.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Sticky nav, footer and dark bands (gallery band). Pair with on-dark and on-dark-muted text.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Dark button fill (btn--dark) on paper and off-white. Hover inverts to paper fill with graphite text.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text on paper, off-white and mist (12.6:1 on paper).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, captions, legend labels on paper and off-white (6.7:1 on paper). Never for headlines.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary section background; light button fill on dark and photo backgrounds; text on ink, charcoal and graphite.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Alternating section background (statement, contact). Alternate with paper; never two off-white sections in a row.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Light-gray fill for Gym C schedule blocks and tab hover. Ink and body text read on it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers and card borders on paper. Not for control borders — those use ink.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on charcoal, ink and photo overlays.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Body text and secondary labels on charcoal (9.4:1) and on photo overlays.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Photo overlay for the hero and photo band (keeps white display type legible).

tokens.name: overlay-strong
tokens.usage: Photo overlay behind long text: testimonial carousel and the About bio.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The ONLY accent. A 6px dot beside TODAY / OPEN NOW labels. Never for text, fills, buttons or decoration.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: H1, desktop hero and statement headline. Sentence case, ends with a period. 72px at ≤1100px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The nav and footer wordmark, set UPPERCASE. No logo mark exists — the name in type is the identity.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: No gimmicks. Just the fundamentals, coached properly.

styles.name: text
styles.sample: I coach one-to-one and in groups of up to six.
styles.usage: Default paragraph text in body color.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.sample: Your body. Your goals. Your lifestyle.
styles.usage: The italic emphasis line under a headline. One per section, max.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Stronger than I was at twenty-five.
styles.usage: Testimonial quote on a dark photo. 22px on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, eyebrows, tabs. Always UPPERCASE.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Small buttons, schedule session type, legend. Always UPPERCASE.

spacing.note: 8px base. Use the steps; never in-between values.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, label stacks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between schedule blocks and gallery tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Slot padding, small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (contact), headline-to-CTA gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header-to-content gap inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Column gap in two-column sections; hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding (top and bottom).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, tabs, cards, slots, photos. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the 6px signal dot.
